caption: “Photographs of two plates of drawings from Prillieux (1869) of transverse sections of frost-frozen petioles of Chelidonium quercifolium (upper drawing) and Symphytum tauricum (lower drawing).” Fig. 1 from M. E. McCully, et al. “The management of extracellular ice by petioles of frost-resistant herbaceous plants.” Annals of Botany 94.5 (2004): 665-74.
alt: Two engraved cross-sections of frozen leaf stalks, numbered 16 and 4: each a ring of small cells around a large open cavity, with darker vein bundles set in the tissue and strands of cells and fine hairs around the edges.
title: Fig. 1
